name: U.S. Route Marker
spec: white shield outline with black numerals 66

snippets.back: A fluorescent yellow-green sign warns of nearby schools, pedestrians, bicycles, playgrounds and school bus routes.
Some roads carry route numbers, and route marker signs show both the route number and the kind of road, such as a U.S. route or a state route.
The illustrated U.S. route marker is a white shield with black route numerals.
U.S. route markers are shields, interstate markers are red, white and blue shields, and North Carolina route markers are diamonds.
Route signs tell you which road you are on and whether it is an interstate, a U.S. route or a state highway.
A U.S. route shield displaying twenty-two identifies U.S. Traffic Route twenty-two.
Route number signs pictured include Interstate Route, US Route and State Route signs, along with the Secondary System Road Marker.
A U.S. route sign shows black numbers on a white shield set on a black background, and a U.S. route continues into other states.
